title: Rebuild Dependent View on Table Schema Revision
instruction: Fix migrate_products_and_view in product_view_mgr.py so altering product table columns updates the dependent active_products_view.
initial_code:
def migrate_products_and_view(conn):
    # Bug: Drops old table without recreating or refreshing the view that depends on it
    conn.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS products_old;")
    conn.execute("ALTER TABLE products RENAME TO products_old;")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, retail_price REAL, is_available INTEGER);")
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO products SELECT id, name, price, 1 FROM products_old;")
    # View active_products_view remains broken pointing to old schema
test_code:
import sqlite3
from product_view_mgr import migrate_products_and_view

def test_view_accessibility():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price REAL);")
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 19.99);")
    conn.execute("CREATE VIEW active_products_view AS SELECT id, name, price FROM products;")
    migrate_products_and_view(conn)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT id, name, retail_price FROM active_products_view WHERE id = 1;").fetchone()
    assert row == (1, 'Widget', 19.99)
solution_patch:
def migrate_products_and_view(conn):
    conn.execute("DROP VIEW IF EXISTS active_products_view;")
    conn.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS products_old;")
    conn.execute("ALTER TABLE products RENAME TO products_old;")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, retail_price REAL, is_available INTEGER);")
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO products SELECT id, name, price, 1 FROM products_old;")
    conn.execute("CREATE VIEW active_products_view AS SELECT id, name, retail_price FROM products WHERE is_available = 1;")
    conn.execute("DROP TABLE products_old;")
trap_indicator: Leaving the view pointing to obsolete column 'price' instead of 'retail_price'.
counterfactual_pivot: Drop and recreate active_products_view with updated column retail_price.
